lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Hello! Are you from the Paragon?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Hello, are you the Student Council President?

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Yup! That's me. How can I help?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Our editorial draft needs the exact list of student demands.

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: I want to give them to you, Kiko, but if we don't cite the exact school charter article, Mr. Reyes will dismiss it.

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: The old Student Council Constitution Handbook is in the library archives.

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Can you find it and bring it to me?

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: The library archives have so many records...

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I found the Student Council Constitution Handbook in the archives!

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Perfect! 'Article IV, Section 2: Student funds shall not be diverted without bilateral consent.'

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Here is the raw list of demands.

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: Bring this to Mrs. Santos at the Publication Office to format and review the editorial before taking it to Reyes!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Time to head to Mrs. Santos in the Publication Office and start formatting the editorial.

lines.speaker: Angel
lines.text: We need that charter article from the handbook before we finalize the demands!
